messages:
Sam: FYI — planned maintenance tonight 23:00 UTC. We need to roll a soft socket reset across AZ2 GPU pools to clear intermittent stuck NVMe io and stalled RDMA sockets. Doing cohorts of ~50 nodes, cordon+drain, rotate, uncordon. Window 23:00-02:00 UTC.
Priya: ETA per cohort? will customer pools be impacted?
Sam: Each cohort ~12m for drain+reboot+warmup, plus 6m buffer. We’ll sequence cohorts with 5m overlap to keep scheduler happy. Customer-hosted and Dedicated pools pinned to capacity tier A will be backfilled to avoid failed jobs.
Alex: Can we avoid full reboots for nodes where only NIC shows stuck queues? i.e. `ethtool -S` to clear?
Sam: Good call — plan is `soc-reset` for net devices where supported, else full soft-reboot. We'll run a quick probe job first to classify nodes. Probe job criteria: RX drops > 5000 or RDMA stalls > 1 per min -> mark NIC-reset candidate.
Jordan: Who’s on-call for rollback if the warmup cache misses spike latency? @deploy-bot do we have an auto-fallback to smaller batch sizes?
deploy-bot: noted. Canary config will be deployed with automatic fallback. If 95p latency > 2.5x baseline for 3 consecutive minutes we switch route to fallback model variants in eu/na.
Priya: Cost note — if we backfill with on-demand instead of spot we estimate ~+$1.1k for the window. Ops budget OK?\anot-needed
Alex: ops-budget says it's fine (confirmed earlier). Can we compress the warmup with prefix cache prefill? I can run prefix-populate for top 200 keys before uncordon.
Sam: Yes — prefill script will run during drain of the cohort. Sequence: 1) cordon 2) drain (grace 60s) 3) run `prefill-prefixes.sh --list top200` 4) socket-probe -> do `soc-reset` or `reboot -f` 5) uncordon 6) run smoke ev tests.
Sam: Pasted playbook snippet:```bash
# cohort rotate playbook (az2)
COHORT_NODES=$(./inventory.py --pool az2-gpu --cohort 50)
for n in $COHORT_NODES; do
  kubectl cordon $n || continue
  kubectl drain $n --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60 || { echo "drain failed $n"; continue; }
  ./prefill-prefixes.sh --nodes $n --list top200
  ./socket-probe --node $n --action auto
  kubectl uncordon $n
done
```
Jordan: Add firewall sanity check before uncordon — last time an ACL rollback caused cross-az auth failures.
Sam: Will add `curl` healthcheck against metadata and model-route with 3 retries. If checks fail, node stays cordoned and goes to remediation queue.
Priya: Noted. I'll update the customer comms: short maintenance blurb + reassurance about A/B fallback.
Alex: Quick ask — can we limit the cohorts to nodes with uptime > 48h to reduce risk of hitting other maintenance windows?
Sam: Yes will filter inventory by uptime. Already scheduled our cohort selection to avoid nodes in upcoming zfs scrub.
Jordan: Logging: ensure we tag all events with `maintenance:socket-reset-2026-03` so billing/ops can attribute.
Sam: Will do. Postmortem channel if anything unexpected.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: maintenance job queued for 2026-03-15T23:00:00Z. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/socket-reset-2026-03
Priya: Thx — pushing final schedule to calendar and sending customers the blurb at 20:00 UTC.
Sam: Thanks team. I’ll post a short start/finish status in here as cohorts begin.
